description: fiba-shot1 (Paris 2024 France-USA) most-accurate K version: the 2VP (f=4510) and 1circle (f=4252) methods selected by held-out geometric evaluation, keeping all 288 frames. Tracked frames carry full geometry; invalid frames keep only the frame identity (geometry columns = null).
coordinates: pixels (origin top-left); vp_* are homogeneous un-normalized (guard |w|>>0 before dividing)
camera_model: K=[[f,0,cx],[0,f,cy],[0,0,1]]; square pixels, zero skew, principal point = frame center; f constant per method
accuracy: held-out cross-validation (gen_K_eval.py): 2VP rank 1, 1circle rank 2. Metric = error of held-out features (free-throw circle roundness / right angles) after rectifying with that K. BA (2397) is a zoom-degraded outlier and is excluded.
null_policy: For tracked=False frames: all geometry columns (f/K/vp/quad/cube/H/tilt/has_ad_quad/n_corners*) = null; only shot/method/present_index/W/H/cx/cy/tracked/visibility are kept.

columns.name: shot
columns.desc: int shot id

columns.name: method
columns.desc: str focal method + px (2VP_4510 or 1circle_4252); best keeps only these two most-accurate methods

columns.name: present_index
columns.desc: int 0-based frame index into shot_0001.mp4

columns.name: f_ref_px
columns.desc: double method focal px (constant per method); null on invalid frames

columns.name: f_frame_px
columns.desc: double == f_ref_px (kept for schema stability)

columns.name: tilt_deg
columns.desc: double floor-normal tilt; null on invalid frames

columns.name: cx
columns.desc: double principal point x = W/2

columns.name: cy
columns.desc: double principal point y = H/2

columns.name: W
columns.desc: int frame width 1920

columns.name: H
columns.desc: int frame height 1080

columns.name: K
columns.desc: double[9] 3x3 row-major intrinsics [f,0,cx,0,f,cy,0,0,1]; null on invalid frames

columns.name: vp_len
columns.desc: double[3] cube X-axis VP (court length / paint long edge r1), homogeneous [x,y,w] this frame; null on invalid frames

columns.name: vp_wid
columns.desc: double[3] cube Y-axis VP (court width r2), homogeneous; null on invalid frames

columns.name: vp_up
columns.desc: double[3] cube Z-axis VP (floor normal r3), homogeneous (w~0 => at infinity); null on invalid frames

columns.name: has_ad_quad
columns.desc: bool ad_quad valid (True on tracked frames); null on invalid frames

columns.name: n_corners_in
columns.desc: int quad corners inside the frame (0..4); null on invalid frames

columns.name: n_corners_out
columns.desc: int corners outside = 4 - n_corners_in; null on invalid frames

columns.name: tracked
columns.desc: bool tracking valid (>=3 corners in-frame). False = ended (>=2 corners out)

columns.name: visibility
columns.desc: str 'tracked' or 'ended'

columns.name: ad_quad
columns.desc: double[8] cube base ring UL,UR,LR,LL px (the tracked ad surface); null on invalid frames

columns.name: cube_verts
columns.desc: double[16] 8 verts (x,y) [b0..b3,t0..t3]; base = ad_quad, top extruded along floor normal; null on invalid frames

columns.name: h_ref_to_i
columns.desc: double[9] 3x3 row-major ref->frame homography (hybrid chained/direct); null on invalid frames

provenance.homography: RAFT dense flow + FB-consistency + USAC_MAGSAC; hybrid direct(231)/chained(57) to fix far frames (gen_homography_chained.py)
provenance.quad: manual paint annotation on the reference frame (quad_drawer --role paint), H-propagated per frame (gen_track/gen_dataset)
provenance.2VP: paint two orthogonal edge VPs -> two_vp_focal_squared (va.detection.vp_algebra)
provenance.1circle: BEV-annotated restricted-area semicircle -> ellipse fit -> map back to image C_img=H^T C_bev H -> circle-IAC (gen_bev_circle.py --from-annot)
